scope: Exact originally pinned and current official Caddy images and supplied reference public-ACME or internal-TLS configurations. Not arbitrary operator commands, image modifications, custom plugins/providers/hooks or a clearance of all advisories absent from these scans.

additional_non_scan_observation.condition: PEM_X509_INFO_read_bio variants receive non-NULL caller stack
additional_non_scan_observation.assessment: Exact c_rehash.c line189 passes NULL as second argument. This supports excluding that helper caller; no all-component OpenSSL clearance is implied.

assessments.required_condition: CMS_encrypt or CMS_encrypt_ex with an attacker-controlled EC recipient certificate of group order 1
assessments.assessment: Caddy uses its static Go crypto implementation for public ACME and internal TLS. Native c_rehash parses/hashes certificates and CRLs; its complete source and dynamic imports have no CMS encryption API. update-ca and BusyBox shell/run-parts link only musl. No supported command runs curl or OpenSSL CMS encryption.
reassess_if: Change service image, package build, compiler/native dependencies or helper code
Add plugins/handlers or native OpenSSL/QUIC/CMS/GCM-SIV/encryption/compression workflows
Add arbitrary helper/curl execution, change certificate-hook directories, mount host trust configuration or allow untrusted image modifications
Ship GDAL or build/install contrib/infback9 functionality

assessments.required_condition: OpenSSL QUIC client processing overlapping retransmitted CRYPTO frames
assessments.assessment: Caddy TLS/HTTP3 is in static Go/quic-go, not OS OpenSSL. Certificate installation helper c_rehash links only libcrypto/musl and has no network or OpenSSL QUIC calls. No supported command invokes the shipped curl client.

assessments.required_condition: Affected GDAL/zlib contrib infback9/inftree9.c decoder clone
assessments.assessment: Alpine zlib1.3.2-r1 APKBUILD configures the normal shared library and runs make/install. SHA512-verified exact source Makefile OBJZ builds infback.o/inftrees.o, not contrib/infback9/inftree9.c. No GDAL package/file is present; exact installed libz exports ordinary inflateBack, not inflateBack9. This is a binary build exclusion for the affected clone, not a blanket zlib exclusion.
